# Test fixtures

Small committed inputs for the tests. These are not Bethesda masters, and no file here is game output beyond the names and counts noted below.

## Plugins

| File | Source | Why it is here |
|------|--------|----------------|
| `FW_HeatherSurvivalPatch.esp` | FO4IDE/PluginEditTool local patch | 2 KB real FO4 plugin with three masters, form version 131, MGEF/SPEL/ALCH groups |
| `SlowTime.esp` | local Fallout 4 Plugins tree | slightly larger real ESP for smoke coverage |

## hkx

| File | Source | Why it is here |
|------|--------|----------------|
| `radroach_turnleft90.animation-manifest.txt` | generated by `BGS/tools/tests/HkxAnimationManifestTests.cs` from `Radicle/tests/fixtures/hkx/Meshes/Actors/RadRoach/Animations/TurnLeft90.hkx` | BGS parity oracle for `Radicle/tests/test_hkx_real.cpp`: declared shape plus first, middle and last pose per track, no game bytes |
| `pairedkill2hmbashkneeandhead_attackerlead.animation-manifest.txt` | generated by `BGS/tools/tests/HkxAnimationManifestTests.cs` from `Radicle/tests/fixtures/hkx/Meshes/Actors/Character/Animations/Paired/PairedKill2HMBashKneeAndHead_AttackerLead.hkx` | BGS parity oracle for the lossless path (`DecodesTheVanillaLosslessClipToTheBgsManifest`): 79 frames, 94 tracks, 2.6 s and 7 annotations; derived numbers only, no game bytes |
| `regenerate-animation-manifest.ps1` | regenerates both manifests with BGS's reader (`WritesTheRequestedClipManifest`) | Depends on the BGS test project, which is being retired; how regeneration survives that is UNVERIFIED |

## papyrus

| File | Why it is here |
|------|----------------|
| `GardenOracleArray.psc`, `GardenOracleEmpty.psc`, `GardenOracleInts.psc`, `GardenOracleState.psc` | Four small Papyrus scripts: an `Int[]` property (`GardenOracleArray`), a declaration only (`GardenOracleEmpty`), an `Int` property with arithmetic (`GardenOracleInts`), and a state with `GotoState` (`GardenOracleState`). No test names them; whether a directory scan uses them is UNVERIFIED |
| `PapyrusFlags.flg` | User-flag table for the CK differential oracle in `Radicle/tests/test_pex_oracle.cpp`: declares the `Hidden` script flag that `graph/BaseStubs` uses on its `Scriptname` lines; format is `flag <Name>` then a bit index, the file `PapyrusCompiler.exe -f=` expects |

## graph

| Path | Why it is here |
|------|----------------|
| `graph/BaseStubs/` (33 `.psc` files and `README.md`) | Declaration-only stand-ins for the base scripts (`ObjectReference`, `Actor`, `Debug`, `Game`, ...). Papyrus import roots for the graph tests (`tests/graph_builder.hpp`, `test_graph_validator.cpp`, `test_graph_node_palette.cpp`, `test_c_api_papyrus_source.cpp`); see its README |
| `graph/GraphScripts/FixtureEventSource.psc` | Fixture Quest script declaring the `AffinityChanged` event used by `tests/graph_fixtures.hpp` |

## swf

| File | Why it is here |
|------|----------------|
| `program_census.txt` | Names and counts only, generated from `Fallout4 - Interface.ba2` (game build 1.10.984.0): 25 Programs movies, 598 ABC blocks. Read by `tests/test_swf_census_real.cpp` |
| `program_replay_pins.txt` | Format header only; no pins are recorded yet. Named in `tests/test_c_api_runtime_real.cpp`. Regression-only, not game evidence |

## previs

| File | Source | Why it is here |
|------|--------|----------------|
| `previs/vanilla_1_11_240_broken.tsv` | originally generated by `previs-measure/mirror_gate6.py` (outside this repo); reproduce the cells with `vanilla_broken_tsv "<Data>" <out.tsv> 1.11.240.0` (target in `RADICLE_BUILD_TOOLS`, source `Radicle/tools/previs/vanilla_broken_tsv.cpp`) from a local Fallout 4 AE 1.11.240.0 Data folder and compare `sort` of both files | pinned broken-cell expectations for `Radicle/tests/test_previs_real.cpp:VanillaLoadOrderGate`; no game bytes. The tool writes Radicle's own verdicts, so its output is a drift check against the pinned table and must be diffed, never committed over it unreviewed; see `docs/code-notes/previs.md` |

Do not vendor `Fallout4.esm` or Creation Club ESLs. Optional live tests may read the game Data directory when present.

Synthetic TES4/GRUP/XXXX/compressed cases are generated in `tests/plugin_bytes.cpp`.
